basics.name: Soham Korade
basics.role: Product Software Engineer at nowon AG
basics.summary: Product Software Engineer at nowon AG, translating music-AI research into production systems. B.Tech CSE (Honors in Cognitive Science) from IIIT Hyderabad. Research interests in computational musicology, MIR, and cognition.

work.name: nowon AG
work.summary: Building music recognition and cue-sheet digitization products for live, broadcast, and platform audio.
highlights: Translating music-AI research into production-ready products by integrating R&D APIs into scalable software systems.
Handling infrastructure; building backend services and full-stack features for music recognition and audio analysis applications.
Owning product features end-to-end — system design, implementation, deployment, and production maintenance — with a focus on reliability and performance.

work.name: Brain, Cognition and Computation Lab, IIIT Hyderabad
work.summary: Research on cognition, grapholinguistics, and related computational methods under Prof. Bapi Raju.
highlights: Honors research topics: Semantic Networks, Chess and Cognition, Graphic Complexity in Writing Systems.

work.name: Walmart Global Tech
work.summary: Full-time software engineering role after graduation.
highlights: Engineered Spring Boot microservices for Multichannel Solutions, including Shopify integration, and independently owned an end-to-end Order Lifecycle Visualizer.
Strengthened service reliability by integrating services with a centralized testing platform, automating deployment pipelines, and improving CI workflows.
Built a forensic log analysis tool to investigate 300+ production errors, identify root causes for 78% of client failures, and uncover a critical P1 seller-facing bug.

work.name: Beatoven.ai
work.summary: Internship at an AI music generation startup.
highlights: Led frontend development; optimized and shipped user-facing features using Next.js.

work.name: IIIT Hyderabad
work.summary: HS1.210 Music Workshop and HS1.209 Music Language Creativity (2 semesters).
highlights: Designed assignments, assisted the professor, and guided students in workshop projects.

work.name: Disney+ Hotstar
work.summary: Android TV and WebOS streaming platforms.
highlights: Worked on Android TV and WebOS platforms, A/B testing, and remote troubleshooting for large-scale streaming.
Built a self-help feature for troubleshooting playback issues, with controlled access via A/B testing for targeted support.

work.name: Walmart Global Tech
highlights: Built seller onboarding frontend for the Chile market (React, Formik).
Optimized form-generation code and documented backend query/mutation APIs.
Selected for the first round of an internal hackathon building an LLM-powered prototype; ranked top 50 of 2500 projects in Walmart Global Techathon '24.

work.name: F9 Hearts
highlights: Built backend for a cloud-based LMS and integrated RESTful APIs with the frontend, following Agile practices.
Honors research: Semantic Networks, Grapholinguistics
Research with Prof. Bapi Raju (cognition, grapholinguistics) and computational musicology with Prof. Saroja TK and Prof. Vinoo Alluri
Teaching Assistant for Music Workshop (2 semesters)
First rank; 99/100 in Computer Science with Python
Chess Nationals (Class XI); Deputy House Captain (Class XII)
CBSE Class X: 95.4% (second rank across sections)

projects.name: Racket Compiler
projects.summary: Compiler for a Racket-inspired language with semantic analysis, static type checking, vector support, and LLVM-based code generation in C++.

projects.name: Enhancing xv6
projects.summary: Extended xv6 with FCFS, Round Robin, PBS, and MLFQ schedulers; implemented strace, sigalarm, and sigreturn; analyzed scheduling tradeoffs and kernel behavior.

projects.name: Bash-like shell
projects.summary: Unix-like shell in C using POSIX system calls: process management, piping, I/O redirection, background execution, and signal handling.

projects.name: Library Sort
projects.summary: Implemented and benchmarked Library Sort in C++ against std::sort, insertion sort, and quicksort on datasets exceeding 10⁶ elements.

projects.name: Barcode Decoding
projects.summary: CNN to detect and preprocess skewed barcodes in images, then decode them.

projects.name: Chess Engine (and GUI)
projects.summary: Chess engine in C++ with minimax, alpha-beta pruning, iterative deepening, and late-move reduction; integrated with the Lichess API and deployed as an online chess bot (@SohamChessBot).

projects.name: JEE Advanced Rank Cutoff Visualizer
projects.summary: Explore/filter/analyze institute-wise cutoff trends (2016–2023). Scraped with bash (curl, wget); cleaned with pandas; visualized with d3.js.

projects.name: Swar Composer
projects.summary: Composition software for Hindustani classical music with MIDI playback/input, Swarlipi parsing, and tabla sync.

projects.name: Raag Identifier
projects.summary: Raga database and detection using N-grams, with FFT-based mic input analysis.

projects.name: Loss Landscape Visualization
projects.summary: Explored neural network loss landscapes and the impact of architecture and training on generalization in VGG and ResNet.

publications.name: A Notation Dataset for Indian Raga Music
publications.summary: Built a dataset of 1,200+ Indian classical music compositions spanning 341 ragas (InRaMu; full corpus: 2,295 compositions in 337 ragas).

publications.name: Raga Space Visualization: Analyzing Melodic Structures in Carnatic and Hindustani Music
publications.summary: Metadata extraction and normalization for symbolic music corpora; TF-IDF, Markov models, UMAP, and t-SNE for retrieval, clustering, and similarity analysis.

publications.name: Graphic Complexity and Orthographic Neighbors: Observations based on Telugu Writing System
publications.publisher: Grapholinguistics in the 21st century—From graphemes to knowledge
publications.summary: Computed graphic complexity metrics for Telugu aksharas and analyzed their relationship to orthographic neighborhood size.
